related_questions.question: What is the ICD-10 code for right hemispheric stroke?

text_blocks.snippet: A right hemispheric stroke, which involves damage to the right side of the brain, is typically coded using I63.XX (for the initial stroke) and I69.351 (if it results in hemiplegia or hemiparesis on the right dominant side) in ICD-10-CM.
snippet_highlighted_words: I63.XX (for the initial stroke) and I69.351 (if it results in hemiplegia or hemiparesis on the right dominant side)

list.title: I63.XX:
list.snippet: This code range (e.g., I63.9, I63.441) is used to classify cerebral infarction (stroke) based on the specific cause, such as thrombosis, embolism, or unspecified occlusion. The specific code within the I63 range depends on the type and location of the stroke. For example, I63.441 refers to a stroke caused by embolism of the right cerebellar artery.

list.title: I69.351:
list.snippet: This code specifically designates "Hemiplegia and hemiparesis following cerebral infarction affecting right dominant side". It is used when the stroke results in weakness or paralysis on the left side of the body (since the right hemisphere controls the left side of the body).

list.title: I69.35X codes:
list.snippet: These codes represent hemiplegia and hemiparesis following cerebral infarction. The specific code depends on whether the right or left side is affected and whether it is the dominant or non-dominant side. I69.351 is specifically for the right dominant side.
The term "right hemispheric stroke" generally refers to a stroke affecting the right cerebral hemisphere of the brain.
Effects of a right hemisphere stroke can include left-sided weakness or paralysis, sensory loss, left-sided neglect (lack of awareness of the left side of space), and vision problems.
Patients may also exhibit behavioral changes like impulsivity, reduced awareness of limitations, and difficulty with attention.

The ICD-10-CM code for a right hemispheric stroke depends on the specific type of stroke and its consequences. For example, if the stroke is due to a blood clot (embolism) in the right cerebellar artery, the code might be I63.441, and if it leads to left-sided weakness (hemiplegia), the code might be I69.351, according to AAPC and ICD-10 Data.
